source: 2025-2028 Southeastern Alaska/Yakutat Areas Commercial Salmon Fishing Regulations
notation: degrees and decimal minutes, e.g. "56° 00.09' N. lat." / "134° 08.16' W. long." — NOT degrees-minutes-seconds; recorded as printed, unconverted. WARNING — typographic defects reproduced verbatim from the source text and NOT silently corrected: (1) District 6 Low Point longitude is printed "132° 57,18' W long." with a COMMA where a decimal point belongs; the identical Low Point in District 8 is printed "132° 57.18' W long.", so the intended value is 132° 57.18' W — a parser must not read this as 132° 57'. (2) District 8 Babbler Point latitude is printed "56° 29.08' W. lat." with W where N belongs; it is a north latitude. (3) Assorted OCR-style corruptions of the abbreviation "lat." appear as "tat." and "Iat." in District 6, and several "lat." are printed "lat" without the period; these affect no numeric value.
provenance: 5 AAC 33.200 could NOT be read from the ADF&G PDF named in source_url: the fetch pipeline truncates that PDF after 5 AAC 30.393 and never reaches chapter 33. The text below was extracted instead from two independently hosted mirrors of the Alaska Administrative Code text of 5 AAC 33.200 — https://www.law.cornell.edu/regulations/alaska/5-AAC-33.200 (Cornell LII) and https://regulations.justia.com/states/alaska/title-5/part-1/chapter-33/article-2/section-5-aac-33-200/ (Justia) — which returned character-identical text including shared typographic defects. These two mirrors may share an upstream digitization, so agreement between them does not prove fidelity to the printed ADF&G booklet. Confirm against the printed booklet before any enforcement or charting use.
